Yale's Modern South Asia Workshop 2027 invites papers from advanced PhD students

The workshop will be held at a location in South Asia on 9 to 11 June 2027, with Yale covering hotels and meals. Applications close on 14 December 2026.

Talaash Heritage desk · Published 26 November 2026

When
9 June 2027 to 11 June 2027
Where
South Asia (venue to be announced)
Apply by
14 December 2026

The South Asian Studies Council at Yale University is taking applications for the 2027 Modern South Asia Workshop (MSAW), an annual meeting at which advanced doctoral students present work-in-progress papers to peers and senior faculty. The 2027 workshop will be held at a location in South Asia, not yet named, from 9 to 11 June 2027. The call is on the council's website and was shared on the INDOLOGY mailing list on 24 November 2026 by Aleksandar Uskokov of the council.

Papers from any humanities or social science discipline are welcome, but this year's call names history, anthropology, political science, architecture and environmental studies as fields of focus, and it particularly invites papers that cross between them. Only work on the modern period, roughly from the mid-18th century to the present, will be considered. The call defines the region as including Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.

Applicants must be PhD students in the humanities or social sciences who have finished all coursework and fieldwork and expect to be writing up or submitting their dissertations by June 2027. Students on terminal master's programmes and recent PhD graduates cannot apply. Yale strongly encourages applicants based at institutions in South Asia.

Yale will pay for hotel rooms and meals for all participants during the workshop. It is prepared to cover return air fares, from the international airport nearest the home institution, for participants based at institutions in South Asia; participants from universities outside the region are strongly encouraged to find additional funding for their air travel.

Applications are made through the workshop's application page and are due by 4 pm US Eastern time on Monday 14 December 2026. Results will be sent by 15 February 2027, and selected participants must submit completed papers by 17 March 2027.

Sources

  1. Modern South Asia Workshop, South Asian Studies Council, MacMillan Center, Yale University, 2026-11-26
  2. Call for Papers: 2027 Yale Modern South Asia Workshop, INDOLOGY mailing list, 2026-11-24
